description: This file defines a wizard interface for creating payment orders based on account move lines, including form definitions, search and creation functions, and a wizard class with states.

classes.name: wizard_payment_order
classes.description: Wizard interface for managing payment order creation with states for initialization, search, and creation.

methods.name: search_entries
methods.description: Searches for account move lines to pay based on due date and updates the form with matching entries.

methods.name: create_payment
methods.description: Creates payment lines in the payment order based on selected move lines and payment preferences.
